description: This Java source file defines the 'HtmlMenuRenderer' class responsible for rendering HTML menus in the Apache OFBiz widget framework. It implements methods for rendering menu items, handling URLs, links, images, and tooltips, and manages state related to user sessions and permissions within the web application's context.

classes.name: HtmlMenuRenderer
classes.description: A renderer class for generating HTML menus within the OFBiz framework, supporting dynamic menu item rendering, URL and link management, session-based user identification, and tooltip handling.

methods.name: getRequest
methods.description: Returns the current HTTP servlet request object.

methods.name: getResponse
methods.description: Returns the current HTTP servlet response object.

methods.name: appendOfbizUrl
methods.description: Generates and appends an OFBiz URL to the provided Appendable writer based on the given location.

methods.name: appendContentUrl
methods.description: Generates and appends a content URL with prefix to the writer for the specified location.

methods.name: appendTooltip
methods.description: Appends a tooltip span element to the writer if the menu item has a tooltip.

methods.name: renderFormatSimpleWrapperRows
methods.description: Renders all menu items as list items within the menu.

methods.name: renderMenuItem
methods.description: Renders a single menu item, including handling for selection, disabling, tooltips, and nested menu items.

methods.name: isDisableIfEmpty
methods.description: Determines if a menu item should be disabled based on context keys.

methods.name: renderMenuOpen
methods.description: Renders the opening HTML structure for a menu, including title and initial list setup.

methods.name: renderMenuClose
methods.description: Completes the menu rendering by closing HTML tags and updating user session info.

methods.name: renderFormatSimpleWrapperOpen
methods.description: Placeholder for rendering wrapper open if needed (empty implementation).

methods.name: renderFormatSimpleWrapperClose
methods.description: Placeholder for rendering wrapper close if needed (empty implementation).

methods.name: setRequest
methods.description: Sets the HttpServletRequest object.

methods.name: setResponse
methods.description: Sets the HttpServletResponse object.

methods.name: setUserLoginIdAtPermGrant
methods.description: Records the user login ID for permission grant tracking.

methods.name: getUserLoginIdAtPermGrant
methods.description: Retrieves the stored user login ID at the time of permission grant verification.

methods.name: isHideIfSelected
methods.description: Determines if a menu item should be hidden when its parent menu is selected.

methods.name: userLoginIdHasChanged
methods.description: Checks whether the user login ID has changed since last session, indicating a login change.

methods.name: getTitle
methods.description: Returns the title of a menu item based on the current context.

methods.name: renderLink
methods.description: Renders an HTML link, optionally handling hidden forms, target windows, images, and link text.

methods.name: renderImage
methods.description: Renders an HTML img element based on image attributes and source URL mode.
